talk_wizard_1:
Hello brave lumberjack!
What brings you to these woods?
talk_player_1:
Hello!
I was sent to rescue a child who was taken by wild beasts that roam this forest.
talk_wizard_2:
Humm...
I don't want to discourage you, but you are the fifth lumberjack sent for this task. So far, none have returned alive and their axes lie scattered among the trees.
talk_player_2:
Don't worry old timer. Lumberjack like me never existed!
I will clear every beast from this forest and rescue the child!
talk_wizard_3:
Yes, confidence is what you don't lack!
Then don't say I didn't warn you!
Good luck!
